generation_scope: Asset references only; no Blender assembly or paid 3D calls in this pass
counting_rule: Count one selected final/reference image per slot and owner. Existing 45 boards are included. Direct analysis crops, previews, renders and superseded experiments stay in the archive without consuming new design slots. Shared designs count once, with multiple reuse tags.
generation_rule: Only verified missing references. Ordinary structural sheets contain 3–4 assemblies; tiny-component packs contain 10–20 objects. Do not generate repeats to fill an allowance. A directly requested full-view assembly may use one full sheet.
revision_rule: Revisions keep a slot and are tracked separately. At most two generator attempts per new slot without a new explicit review of the rejection reason; no automatic retries.
